title: pyrus umbellularia
intro: Pyrus umbellularia, commonly known as May cherry or Mountain Pepper, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the mountainous regions of China and Japan. This plant is valued for its therapeutic properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting immune function due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus umbellularia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
